source: working tree with A2 acceptance additions; isolated local stack; fixtures accumulated across repeated runs

projects.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM project_members WHERE user_id=%s

completed_mock_runs.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM runs r WHERE status='completed' AND model='deterministic-v1' AND (user_id=%s OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm WHERE pm.project_id=r.project_id AND pm.user_id=%s))

active_development_deployments.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM deployments d JOIN prompts p ON p.id=d.prompt_id WHERE status='active' AND environment='dev' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm WHERE pm.project_id=p.project_id AND pm.user_id=%s)

pending_approvals.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM deployments WHERE status='pending' AND environment='prod'

version_history.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM prompt_versions WHERE prompt_id=%s
